title: Rich text editor content sanitization

requirements.text: Editor HTML is sanitized on the trusted server with an allowlist before it is stored or rendered; client-side cleaning is not relied on
Scripts, event handlers, style attributes, iframes, SVG/MathML and mutation-XSS shapes are removed
Links keep only http, https and mailto (after URL decoding) and get a forced safe rel
The formatting the editor emits (headings, lists, emphasis, links, code) survives sanitization
When the editor stores JSON (ProseMirror/Lexical), the document is validated against the editor schema before it is rendered
Images and embeds are limited to allowed hosts or the app's own uploads
Saved content has a byte and nesting limit enforced by the server

implementations.notes: Pinned allowlist sanitizers in 9 languages, each with an XSS-corpus and formatting test under examples/cookbook; no tests/ test runs the sanitizer itself. The allowlist drops img, so media handling is the app's policy

notes: The cookbook guide documents the Tiptap/Lexical JSON path (generateHTML then sanitize) but no code validates editor JSON.
